waymoWeeklyRidesSource.publisher: Alphabet Q1 2026 earnings call, Sundar Pichai's remarks

throughput.note: Waymo is the only operator that publishes paid ride volume. Tesla does not publish rides, active fleet or rides per vehicle.

benchmarks.title: Community ride receipts: median fare
benchmarks.takeaway: On what riders actually paid, Tesla's median ride now costs about 9% less than Waymo's, with shorter trips.

source.publisher: Robotaxi Tracker pricing (rider receipts, tax included, medians)

benchmarks.title: Same receipts, by city (median fare per ride)
benchmarks.takeaway: Tesla is cheaper per ride in Austin and Dallas; in the Bay Area its median ride is longer (8.4 mi) and costs more. Austin Waymo has only 9 logged rides.

benchmarks.title: Obi: Tesla prices up 41%, still cheapest
benchmarks.takeaway: Every service got pricier versus late 2025. Tesla rose most but was still the cheapest every day, roughly half Waymo's average price.

source.publisher: Obi, Tesla Robotaxi Prices Are Up 41% In San Francisco (21 Apr 2026)

benchmarks.title: Obi: average price per ride, 94,348 quotes
benchmarks.takeaway: Tesla (Bay Area rides with a safety driver) averaged $8.17 a ride against $15.47 to $19.69 for Lyft, Uber and Waymo.

source.publisher: Obi, The Cost of Autonomy (27 Jan 2026)

benchmarks.title: Reported Austin rate card
benchmarks.takeaway: $3.00 plus $1.40 a mile: a 5 mile ride is $10.00, a 10 mile ride $17.00. A reported card, not a live quote; the app prices each trip.

source.publisher: Not a Tesla App, Tesla Raises Robotaxi Price Again With 40% Increase (12 Mar 2026)
